subject: Charge I did not make at Harbourline Electronics
body: Hello, there is a charge of $212.40 from Harbourline Electronics on 2 October that I did not make. I have attached my statement, the merchant's receipt they emailed me, and a note from my phone showing I was in Moncton that day. Please reverse it.
